_doc: More social encounters (npcs) and towns. See scripts/campaign/social.gd.

npcs.name: The Lock-Keeper
npcs.greeting: The gate. Is shut. Shut. Who. Who goes.
npcs.tell: He respects. A firm hand. Money. Money is for. Cowards.

hit: You. Could have. Been a soldier.
hate: Coin. Coin. To a sentry. Shame.
bribe: He drops it. Into the lock. Plunk.

win.text: He winds the gate up. Behind it: the next stretch of water, and a crate nobody claimed.

lose.text: He opens the sluice. On you.

npcs.name: The Bell Diver
npcs.greeting: Bell. Down there. Still. Ringing. You hear. You hear it.
npcs.tell: He wants. Someone to say. They hear it too. True or. Not.

hate: Hands off. Off. I hold my breath. Longer than you. Live.
bribe: Coins. For the bell. It eats them.

win.text: He goes down. He comes up with something from inside the bell.

lose.text: He takes the slowest of you down to hear it properly.

npcs.name: The Anatomist
npcs.greeting: Lie down. Down. I only. Want. To look.
npcs.tell: He likes. Quiet patients. And paying ones. Begging. Makes him. Cut. Faster.

like: Yes. A good patient. Very good.
hate: Begging. Begging. The bad ones. Beg.

win.text: He sews something useful into one of you. It barely shows.

lose.text: He looks. With his hands. With his tools.

npcs.name: The Woman in Pew Four
npcs.greeting: This seat. Is taken. Saved. He's coming back. Steve is. Coming back.
npcs.tell: She wants. Someone to be sorry. Properly. She can smell. A lie.

hit: You. Can sit. At the end.
like: You'd have liked him. Everyone. Liked him.
hate: Don't you. Don't you raise your voice. In his pew.
bribe: She puts it in his hymn book. For when he's back.

win.text: She gives you his lucky thing. 'He won't. Need it. Now. Will he.'

lose.text: She screams his name. Something answers from seat four.

npcs.name: The Claim Jumper
npcs.greeting: That's. My. Hole. In the ground. Mine.
npcs.tell: He only. Respects. Two things. A gun. Or gold. Smile at him and. He shoots.

hate: Smiling. Smiling at a man. With a pick.
bribe: He bites it. Twice. Pockets it.

win.text: He sells you the claim cheap. There's something down there already.

lose.text: He calls his partners. They have picks.

npcs.name: The Switchman
npcs.greeting: Lever. One. Lever. Two. Which track. Which. Track.
npcs.tell: He wants. To hear. The train's. Running on time. Even if. It isn't.

like: Yes. Yes. The 9:14. Right on time.
hate: Please. Please. Kevin. Never said please. Kevin. Never said. Anything.

win.text: He throws a lever. The road ahead bends somewhere better.

npcs.name: The Prop Master
npcs.greeting: Props. Props. Everything back. In its box. Everything.
npcs.tell: She likes. Being paid. And told. The props are. Lovely.

miss: That's not. A prop. Put it down.
hate: Touch me and. You go in. A box.
bribe: Petty cash. Thank you. Thank you.

win.text: She lends you something off the prop table. 'Bring it. Back. Nobody. Brings it back.'

npcs.name: Janet (Understudy)
npcs.greeting: Hi. Hi. I'm. Janet. Tonight. Tonight I'm Janet.
npcs.tell: Janet liked. Liars. And charmers. She cheated. She'd know. Begging won't. Fool her. Money. Insults her.

like: Oh. You're good. You're. Really good.
hate: Begging. He liked it. When I begged. Don't.
Money? I never. Needed. His money.
bribe: She lets the coin roll off the table. Into his tray.

win.text: Janet leans in. She tells you exactly how long he looks away, and what to do with it.

lose.text: The tape on the face comes loose. It isn't Janet. It was never Janet. 'Cheat.'

npcs.name: The Coat Check
npcs.greeting: Ticket. Ticket. Nobody. Ever. Brings the ticket.
npcs.tell: She wants. Someone to. Hear about the coats. Tips. Insult her.

hate: A tip. A TIP. For their. Coats.
bribe: She drops it in the lost property box. With the teeth.

win.text: She gives you a coat that isn't yours. It's warm inside. Recently warm.

lose.text: She keeps something of yours. 'Ticket. Next time.'

npcs.name: The Runner
npcs.greeting: Eyes down. Eyes. Down. Who's got. A full house.
npcs.tell: She runs the cards. Between tables. She likes. Nice faces. And tips. And she checks. Every number.

hate: Checked. Checked it. That's not. On your card.
bribe: Into the apron. She winks. With the wrong eye.

win.text: She slips you a card that's already half daubed.

lose.text: False call. The whole hall turns to look at you.

towns.name: Lockgate
towns.intro: Lockgate. The water. Is held back. Here. For now. For. Now. The bell rings twice.

places.name: The Lock
places.desc: A gate, a winch, a man in rusted armour.

places.name: The Chandlery
places.desc: Rope, tar, and dead men's boots.

places.name: The Bell-House
places.text: It rings under the water. Something rings back, very far down.

places.name: The Harbour Wall

effects.text: Bounty: land two critical hits next fight

places.text: WANTED, written over the names. The names are older. Some are seat numbers.

places.name: The Pier
places.desc: Somebody is waiting on the pier.

towns.name: The Infirmary
towns.intro: The Infirmary. Visiting hours. Are. Now. Are. Always. Two visits. Then. Lights out.

places.name: The Ward
places.desc: Rows of beds. One is being prepared for you.

places.name: The Dispensary
places.desc: Behind a grille. The labels are handwritten.

places.name: Bloodletting
places.text: Bowls fill. You feel lighter. Then, oddly, stronger.

places.name: The Night Desk
places.desc: A bed for the night. 15 gold.
places.text: A nurse checks on you every hour. You never see her come in. You never hear her go.
